units.source_text: 云居雁看见父亲近来异常忧愁，觉得此身可耻可悲，以致意气消沉。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari saw that her father had lately been unusually troubled, and she felt her own situation to be shameful and sad, so that her spirits sank.

units.source_text: 但脸上不露声色，装作若无其事，只是闷闷不乐地度日。

en.t: Yet she showed nothing on her face and pretended that nothing was wrong, spending her days only in silent melancholy.

units.source_text: 夕雾每逢刻骨相思、痛苦难堪之时，便写缠绵悱恻的情书，寄与云居雁。

en.t: Whenever Yugiri was overcome by longing that cut to the bone and by unbearable pain, he wrote deeply tender love letters and sent them to Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 云居雁应有“谁人可信任”之叹。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari must have sighed, wondering whom she could trust.

units.source_text: 倘是老于世故的人，也许会疑心夕雾对她是否诚心。

en.t: Someone more experienced in the ways of the world might have doubted whether Yugiri was truly sincere toward her.

units.source_text: 但她并不怀疑，每次读了来信，总是不胜悲伤。

en.t: But she did not doubt him, and whenever she read his letters, she was always overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 外间有人传说：“中务亲王已请得源氏太政大臣同意，将女儿许配夕雾中将，正在说亲。”

en.t: Outside, people were saying, The Prince of Nakatsukasa has already obtained the consent of Genji, the Grand Minister, and is arranging to give his daughter in marriage to Lieutenant General Yugiri.

units.source_text: 内大臣闻此消息，重又悲痛起来，胸怀为之郁结。

en.t: When the Minister of the Interior heard this news, his grief returned, and his heart became heavy and blocked with distress.

units.source_text: 他悄悄地对云居雁说：“听说夕雾要娶中务亲王的女儿了。

en.t: He quietly said to Kumoi no Kari, I hear that Yugiri is going to marry the daughter of the Prince of Nakatsukasa.

units.source_text: 此人真无情啊！

en.t: How heartless he is!

units.source_text: 从前太政大臣曾经向我开口，要我将你许配夕雾，那时我执念甚强，不曾答应。

en.t: In the past, the Grand Minister once approached me and asked that I give you in marriage to Yugiri, but at that time I was stubbornly attached to my own feelings and did not agree.

units.source_text: 想是为此之故，他另行择人了。

en.t: I suppose it is because of that that he has chosen someone else.

units.source_text: 现在我若让步，允其昔日之请，岂不被人耻笑！”

en.t: If I were to yield now and grant his former request, would I not be laughed at by everyone?

units.source_text: 说时泪盈于睫。

en.t: As he spoke, tears filled his lashes.

units.source_text: 云居雁觉得十分可耻，不禁淌下泪来。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari felt deeply ashamed and could not help letting tears fall.

units.source_text: 又觉难以为情，将身转向一旁，姿态娇艳无限。

en.t: Then, feeling even more embarrassed, she turned aside, and her figure was endlessly lovely and graceful.

units.source_text: 内大臣睹此情景，想道：“此事如何是好？

en.t: Seeing this, the Minister of the Interior thought, What should be done about this?

units.source_text: 看来只得开口求人了。”

en.t: It seems I have no choice but to open my mouth and ask for help.

units.source_text: 他满腹心事地走出室去。

en.t: With his heart full of worries, he left the room.

units.source_text: 云居雁依旧独坐窗前，凝神闲眺。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari still sat alone by the window, gazing out quietly in deep thought.

units.source_text: 她想：“我怎么会如此伤心，以致淌下泪来呢？

en.t: She thought, Why did I become so sad that I shed tears?

units.source_text: 不知父亲作何感想？”

en.t: I wonder what Father thought of it.

units.source_text: 万种思量，涌上心来。

en.t: A thousand thoughts welled up in her heart.

units.source_text: 正在此时，夕雾派人送信来了。

en.t: Just then, Yugiri sent someone with a letter.

units.source_text: 云居雁虽有不快之感，终于启读来信。

en.t: Although Kumoi no Kari felt displeased, in the end she opened the letter and read it.

units.source_text: 但见信中语言甚详，诗云：

en.t: She saw that the letter spoke at great length, and the poem said:
